headline: Set Community Pool pass fees for 2027 and voted to consider naming a Pragemann Park field after former Director Stanley Shepardson.
summary: The Commission approved new Community Pool Park pass fees for adults, children, seniors, and daily guests, and voted that seasonal passes will be for residents only. It also voted to consider naming Field 1 at Pragemann Park in honor of former Parks & Recreation Director Stanley Shepardson. The Commission briefly discussed camp use and fees, with discussion to continue, and approved the September 2, 2026 minutes.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 2, 2026 meeting.
Approved Community Pool pass fees: Adults $75, Children (under 18) $50, Seniors (62+) $50, Children under 2 free, Daily Resident and Guest Passes $10 per day.
Approved limiting Seasonal Pool Passes to residents only.
Approved considering naming Field 1 at Pragemann Park in honor of Stanley Shepardson.

decision_evidence.quote: A motion was made by Dave Anderson and seconded by Steve Rossacci to approve the minutes of September 2, 2026. Unanimously Approved.

Steve Rossacci made a motion to set the Pool Pass Fees as follows: Adults - $75 / Children (under 18 yrs old) - $50 / Seniors (62 yrs old +) - $50 / Children under 2 yrs old - Free / Daily Resident and Guest Passes - $10 per day. Seconded by Dave Anderson. Unanimously approved.
Dave Anderson made a motion that Seasonal Pool Passes will be for residents only. Seconded by Lars Edeen. Unanimously approved.
Lars Edeen made a motion to consider naming Field 1 at Pragemann Park in honor of Stanley Shepardson. Seconded by Dave Anderson. Unanimously approved.

plain_text:
Wallingford Parks & Recreation Commission 
Special Meeting - Minutes 
Wednesday, October 7, 2026 @ 5:30pm 
6 Fairfield Blvd, Wallingford 
Conference Room 4 
 
  Meeting was called to order at 5:30pm. 
1. Pledge of Allegiance  
2. Roll Call   
Commissioners in Attendance: Don Crouch, Steve Rossacci, Dave Anderson,  
and Lars Edeen  
Commissioners Absent: Lori Cooke Marra 
Recreation Staff in Attendance: Director - Kenny Michaels 
3. Public Comments (10 minutes total time) - None 
4. Approval of Minutes: September 2, 2026  
A motion was made by Dave Anderson and seconded by Steve Rossacci to approve 
the minutes of September 2, 2026. Unanimously Approved.  
5. Reports  
a. Director - Kenny Michaels reviewed his Directors Report. (attached) 
b. Project Updates – See Directors Report 
 i. Community Pool Park – See Directors Report 
c. Chairman – Chairman Crouch stated that he will add Discussion on the Non-profit 
 Fees to the next meeting agenda. Commissioner Rossacci mentioned that the Town 
 Council Ordinance Committee is working on an ordinance for non-profit leasing and 
 purchasing of town property. The Commission will monitor the ordinance to see if it 
 pertains to Parks & Recreation. The Commission will review potential areas on how the 
 Commission can assist the Director and the department (possible examples: Fee 
 Waivers, Program Suspension Appeals) and revising the Ordinance on the ability to set 
 rental fees for use of parks, pavilions, and facilities. 
 
6. Old Business - None 
7. New Business  
a. Discussion and Possible Action: Community Pool Program Fees – Commission 
discussed the fees for residents. They reviewed the proposed fees from the 2019 
presentation to Town Council vs the cost to run the Community Pool Park in 2027.  
Steve Rossacci made a motion to set the Pool Pass Fees as follows: Adults - $75 / 
Children (under 18 yrs old) - $50 / Seniors (62 yrs old +) - $50 / Children under 2 
yrs old - Free / Daily Resident and Guest Passes - $10 per day. Seconded by Dave 
Anderson. Unanimously approved. 
Dave Anderson made a motion that Seasonal Pool Passes will be for residents 
only. Seconded by Lars Edeen. Unanimously approved. 
 - Commission had a brief discussion on camp use and fees. Discussion to be 
 continued.  
b. Discussion and Possible Action: Honoring former Parks & Recreation Director Stanley 
Shepardson – Mr. Shepardson was the 1st Director of Wallingford Parks & Recreation 
from March of 1967 – September of 1995. Commission discussed how he was 
instrumental in many aspects of the Parks & Recreation Department, including the 
purchase of Pragemann Park.
Lars Edeen made a motion to consider naming Field 1 at Pragemann Park in 
honor of Stanley Shepardson. Seconded by Dave Anderson. Unanimously 
approved. 
8. Commission Around Town - None 
9. Adjournment – meeting adjourned at 6:30pm. Motion to adjourn made by Steve Rossacci, 
seconded by Lars Edeen. Unanimously approved. 
  
Next Meeting: December 9, 2026 @ 5:30pm    
 
Respectfully submitted, 
Stacey Hoppes 
Parks & Recreation Commission Secretary
